summary: Led a team of 3 designers in a national digital transformation initiative, delivering UX improvements across 8 public services.

Created the Henaket design system, adopted by major government agencies (MIA, MOH, Rescue Service) and third-party vendors, contributing to a 34% increase in citizen engagement through improved usability and accessibility while collaborating cross-functionally to streamline digital service delivery.
Collaborated with large international teams on global healthcare and pharma projects (HCA Healthcare, Novartis, SPARKD), conducting user research to inform UX decisions.
Delivered wireframes, design documentation, and scalable design system contributions, helping Novartis scientists reduce research time by 44% through improved usability and workflow optimization.
